question: Among drivers who had at least one accident (statusId = 3) in the Canadian Grand Prix, find the one with the slowest lap time in lap 3 of any French Grand Prix they participated in. Return their full name and nationality.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
JOIN races fr ON lt.XCL_043 = fr.XCL_065
WHERE fr.XCL_069 = 'French Grand Prix'
  AND lt.XCL_045 = 3
  AND d.XCL_034 IN (
      SELECT r.XCL_075
      FROM results r
      JOIN races cr ON r.XCL_074 = cr.XCL_065
      WHERE cr.XCL_069 = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
        AND r.XCL_090 = 3
  )
ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 DESC
LIMIT 1
